result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but one prominent loading indicator appears stuck over already rendered content, and horizontal carousels are awkwardly clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: A large loading spinner remains centered on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image even though the image has already rendered, obscuring the card artwork.
issues.suggestion: Remove the loading overlay as soon as the image finishes loading, or show a skeleton only while content is genuinely unavailable.

issues.description: The category and “Fastest near you” horizontal rows end with partially visible items at the right edge; the third restaurant’s image and name are abruptly clipped.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent carousel padding and a deliberate partial-card preview, ensuring text stays within its card and is truncated cleanly with an ellipsis if necessary.
